findings.body: A repo pinned to `v1.3.0-rc.1` cannot run `forge upgrade v1.3.0`: this regex discards the prerelease suffix, so line 79 treats the versions as equal and refuses. Such pins remain accepted by `src/forge/repo.py:142` and validated at line 311, while [SemVer precedence](https://semver.org/#spec-item-11) makes the stable release newer. Preserve the prerelease distinction in the comparison. This previously reported issue remains unresolved.
findings.title: Compare prerelease pins before rejecting their stable release
